Landmark #1

Historic Grandstand, Clubhouse & Turf Club (1934–2008)

Built by William P. Kyne in 1934 (where Seabiscuit won the 1937 & 1938 Bay Meadows Handicap). Today, its footprint sits directly along the east side of South Delaware Street between East 28th and East 31st Ave, across from the relocated Hillsdale Caltrain Station and Roblox HQ.
